# SvgOptions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Options for [`Svg`](svg.md).

`svgData`, `filePath` and `svgGenerator` are mutually exclusive sources; supply one. `filePath` is Node-only; the others are universal.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type SvgOptions = ElementOptions & Partial<Omit<Pick<Svg, (typeof SVG_OWN_OPTION_KEYS)[number]>, 'fitMode' | 'width' | 'height'>> & {
    /** Width. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    width?: LengthInput;
    /** Height. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'2cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`. */
    height?: LengthInput;
    /** How the drawing fills its box. Accepts `'contain' | 'cover' | 'fill' | 'fit-height' | 'actual-size'`. */
    fitMode?: ImageFitModeInput;
}
```

- [`breakAllowed`](#breakallowed): Whether this element can be split across page boundaries.
- [`captureName`](#capturename): Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot.
- [`contentDirection`](#contentdirection): Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.
- [`filePath`](#filepath): Path to an SVG file; Node only (mutually exclusive with `svgData` and `svgGenerator`).
- [`fitMode`](#fitmode): How the drawing fills its box.
- [`height`](#height): Height.

- [`keepWithNext`](#keepwithnext): Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

- [`strictUnsupportedFeatures`](#strictunsupportedfeatures): When `true` (the default), a document using a feature outside the supported profile fails generation, naming every such feature.
- [`svgData`](#svgdata): SVG markup (mutually exclusive with `filePath` and `svgGenerator`).
- [`svgGenerator`](#svggenerator): Produces the markup for the box it is given, in points (mutually exclusive with `svgData` and `filePath`).

### `altText`

```typescript
altText?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Alternate text for accessibility. Under PDF/UA-1 it becomes the figure's `/Alt`. When not set, reads as the document's own `<title>`, which is used in its place.

### `breakAllowed`

```typescript
breakAllowed?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Whether this element can be split across page boundaries. When false, the element is treated as atomic and will be moved to a new page rather than split. If it doesn't fit on a fresh page either, it renders anyway. Default is true.

### `captureName`

```typescript
captureName?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Optional author-supplied name/key surfaced in the layout snapshot. Unset by default; a future capture API can populate it.

### `contentDirection`

```typescript
contentDirection?: ContentDirectionInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Inline progression and paragraph base direction; omitted inherits.

### `filePath`

```typescript
filePath?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

Path to an SVG file; Node only (mutually exclusive with `svgData` and `svgGenerator`).

### `fitMode`

```typescript
fitMode?: ImageFitModeInput | undefined
```

*optional*

How the drawing fills its box. Accepts `'contain' | 'cover' | 'fill' | 'fit-height' | 'actual-size'`.

### `height`

```typescript
height?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Height. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'2cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `isDecorative`

```typescript
isDecorative?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

When `true`, the drawing is decorative and tagged as an artifact, with no alt-text finding.

### `keepWithNext`

```typescript
keepWithNext?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

Keeps this element with the start of its next sibling in vertical flow.

### `margin`

```typescript
margin?: ThicknessInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Margin around this element. Accepts `12`, `[h, v]`, `[l, t, r, b]` or `{ bottom: 12 }`; omitted sides are zero.

### `strictUnsupportedFeatures`

```typescript
strictUnsupportedFeatures?: boolean | undefined
```

*optional*

When `true` (the default), a document using a feature outside the supported profile fails generation, naming every such feature. When `false`, the rest is drawn and each skipped feature is a diagnostic - or, with an SVG rasterizer registered on the document and the async generate path, drawn as an image in its place.

### `svgData`

```typescript
svgData?: string | undefined
```

*optional*

SVG markup (mutually exclusive with `filePath` and `svgGenerator`).

### `svgGenerator`

```typescript
svgGenerator?: ((size: SvgSize) => string) | undefined
```

*optional*

Produces the markup for the box it is given, in points (mutually exclusive with `svgData` and `filePath`). The box cannot come from markup that does not exist yet, so a generator needs both `width` and `height`.

### `width`

```typescript
width?: LengthInput | undefined
```

*optional*

Width. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'1cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.
